description: Unidentified Hunter in grey-green camouflage, no serial visible, pole-mounted outside the AFS Ambala main gate since about 2005 (WBI, 2023).

Last-built IAF MiG-23BN and among the last airworthy in Nov 2008 (photographed at Halwara by Phil Camp); pole-mounted all-silver at Alexandra Road/Gunners Avenue opposite St Paul Cathedral, installed before Sept 2015 (WBI).
MiG-21U two-seater in service 1974-2013, last with 3 Sqn; on a concrete pedestal at the Tejas Road/Durand Road corner of the cathedral grounds with a history plaque, installed before Nov 2016 (WBI).
